body: We start with how your family uses each room — where you cook, store, work and rest — and design the interior around it.
Because the furniture, kitchen, storage and woodwork are made in our own factory, what we draw is what gets built, to the millimetre.
caps: Full-home interiors
Living, dining, bedrooms and study planned as one coherent home.
Villas & independent houses
From a single floor to the whole villa, coordinated from plan to handover.
Kitchens & storage
Modular kitchens and built-in storage made in our factory.
Doors & woodwork
Wooden doors, panelling and custom joinery, machined in-house.

body: Offices, receptions and commercial spaces need to look right for your business and stand up to daily use. We plan for both from the first drawing.
Workstations, storage, reception counters and joinery are made in our own factory, so finishes stay consistent across the whole floor.
caps: Corporate offices
Workstations, cabins and storage planned around how your team works.
Receptions & meeting rooms
The first thing clients see, detailed with care.
Commercial & retail spaces
Durable fit-outs with joinery made to measure.
Brand details
Material details that carry your identity through the space.

body: Modular kitchens are most of what our factory makes. We measure on site, plan the layout around how you cook, and build every cabinet ourselves.
Laminates, edge banding and finishing are done in-house — so edges are clean, shutters line up and the finish matches from the first cabinet to the last.
caps: Layout planning
Measured on site and planned around how you cook and store.
Factory-made cabinets
Carcasses and shutters cut and assembled in our own factory.
Laminate & edge banding
Applied in-house for clean, durable edges.
Finishes & hardware
Shutters, counters and handles chosen with you, with real samples.

body: Our workshop has the woodworking machinery to make modular furniture, wooden doors and custom woodwork to your exact dimensions.
Each piece is finished in-house, so it matches the rest of your interior — the same laminate, the same edge, the same care.
caps: Modular furniture
Units made in our factory to fit your rooms exactly.
Wooden doors
Doors machined and finished in our workshop.
Custom woodwork
Panelling, shelving and bespoke pieces made to measure.
In-house finishing
Laminate, edge banding and finish applied by our own team.
